title: Carve 0.2 containers
description: Each block that owns lines past its first: how a later line stays inside it, what closes it and how its body is read. An open paragraph inside any of them also takes lazy lines (C2-B-012). Sorted by name.

name.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

kind.description: `container`: the body holds blocks, items or entries. `leaf`: the body holds lines or opaque text.

items.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

continues.description: How a line continues the block. `prefix_mark`: the line carries the quote mark. `indent_past_marker`: with no paragraph open, the line is indented past the marker column of the block (C2-B-025). `sibling_marker`: the line is a marker that matches the list. `until_closer`: every line the enclosing container owns, up to the closer.

closes_on.description: What closes the block. The cited clauses define each case.

clauses.description: The clause ids of the six 0.2 documents that the row encodes. The row is normative together with these clauses.

sigil.description: For a sigil div, the character after the colon run and its one space.

closed_by.description: The identifier of the row, unique in its list.

body.description: `blocks`: read as blocks. `items`, `entries`: the children of a list. `lines`: one leaf in which only prefixes and the closer are recognized. `opaque`: not read for blocks, inline content or comments.

strip.description: The most that is stripped from the start of each body line (C2-B-027, C2-B-029).

bare_paragraph.description: Which paragraph of the body is rendered without its paragraph element. Every other paragraph gets one.

counts_toward_depth.description: True when an open block of this kind counts one toward the depth cap (C2-B-190). Absent: it does not count.

unclosed_report.description: The diagnostic code that reports the block when it ends without its closer. An id of lint-rules.json.
